from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,datetime
rows=[]
def run(args):
 started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 row={'argv':args,'started_utc':started,'finished_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'returncode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr};rows.append(row);return p
result={'contract':'recoveryAdmissionAction/v1','boot_id':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),'actions':rows,'dma_idle_proven':False,'dma_submitted':False,'reset_executed':False,'sram_programmed':False,'status':'blocked'}
try:
 devs=[p for p in Path('/sys/bus/pci/devices').iterdir() if p.joinpath('vendor').read_text().strip()=='0x0755' and p.joinpath('device').read_text().strip()=='0x0755']
 assert len(devs)==1,'Ambiguous FPGA endpoint'
 dev=devs[0];parent=dev.resolve().parent
 assert dev.name=='0002:21:00.0' and parent.name=='0002:20:00.0','Board topology changed'
 assert Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()=='dd39b8d1-cf2d-404e-914d-45eb87278794','Boot changed'
 owners=run(['fuser','-v','/dev/pango_pci_driver']);assert owners.returncode==1 and not owners.stdout.strip() and not owners.stderr.strip(),'Device owner/ownership query error'
 before=run(['setpci','-s',dev.name,'COMMAND']);assert before.returncode==0 and len(before.stdout.strip())==4 and not before.stderr.strip(),'Config read failed'
 old=int(before.stdout.strip(),16);assert old!=0xffff,'Endpoint unreachable'
 action=run(['setpci','-s',dev.name,'COMMAND=0000:0004']);assert action.returncode==0 and not action.stderr.strip(),'BME masked write failed'
 after=run(['setpci','-s',dev.name,'COMMAND']);assert after.returncode==0 and len(after.stdout.strip())==4 and not after.stderr.strip(),'Config readback failed'
 new=int(after.stdout.strip(),16);assert new==old & ~4,'BME or other Command bits mismatch'
 result.update(status='bus_master_disabled',endpoint=dev.name,parent_bridge=parent.name,command_before=hex(old),command_after=hex(new),bit_mask='0x0004',reset_pending=True)
except BaseException as error:result['error']=str(error)
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
